items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: the best ever was Jimmy Blanton, Sam Stuart, Red Calendar (inaudible), just no competition.

ctx.x: Oh, I see, yes. Do you remember any times when there were contests, that you were exceptionally good?
No, I wasn't in -- the best ever was Jimmy Blanton, Sam Stuart, Red Calendar (inaudible), just no competition.
You mean in terms of Blanton?
